H4_required_fields.G4_normalization_contract: must reuse the G4 primitive without choosing it from Higgs observations
H4_required_fields.Higgs_projection_certificate: must prove the rows project to the |phi|^4 self-interaction slot
H4_required_fields.exactness_or_error_certificate: must provide exact arithmetic or certified numerical bounds
H4_required_fields.finite_trace_or_pairing_source_id: must be theorem-derived or independently emitted
H4_required_fields.second_or_fourth_variation_rows: must emit the nonlinear Hessian/quartic rows or an exact finite formula
H4_required_fields.selected_Higgs_zero_mode_or_amplitude_co: must identify the H-sector scalar/amplitude coordinate in the selected finite basis
H4_required_fields.selected_nonlinear_action_or_PhiFin_sour: must name the same selected source, not a replay functional
H4_required_fields.selected_variation_space_id: must include admissible Higgs-amplitude variations before residual projection
H4_required_fields.selector_guardrail: must exclude observed Higgs, SM masses, CKM/PMNS, weak angle, alpha, RG benchmark values, and target lambda_H as selectors

G4_normalization_contract.tier: shared one-metrology primitive; not Higgs-specific and not no-knob

exactness_or_error_certificate.missing_payload: exact arithmetic or certified numerical bound for the H-sector row, not just SI-1c source rows

second_or_fourth_variation_rows.missing_payload: actual selected nonlinear H-sector fourth-variation row or exact finite formula
